highlights: Introducing the Porodo Nomad Smart Watch, a feature-rich and versatile wearable designed to keep up with your active lifestyle.
Powered by a powerful 290mAh battery, enjoy up to 5 days of continuous use in Bluetooth mode and a standby time of 15 days.
It gets fully charged in just 2 hours, so you are always ready. It is powered by the JL7012A operating system, and the screen is 1.54" in size, boasting a 240 x 240 resolution TFT screen.
Real-time notifications keep you updated with messages, calls, and updates on social media without necessarily reaching for your phone.
The voice assistant allows you hands-free command; capturing moments is a breeze with the camera shutter function.
Never misplace your phone again with the "Find Phone" feature, conveniently positioned.
Besides monitoring activity and tracking the progress of goals, a range of health and fitness tracking abilities is also available with the Porodo Nomad Smart Watch.
